Container.Name: overtime-tracker
Container.Overview: Log overtime hours worked and check each payslip pays them correctly. AI-written personal project - use at your own risk.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Where the overtime database is stored

Config.Name: Time zone
Config.Description: Used for today's date when logging overtime

Config.Name: Username
Config.Description: Optional. Username for the web UI login. Leave both username and password empty to run without a login.

Config.Name: Password
Config.Description: Optional. Password for the web UI login. Set both or neither.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID the app runs as

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID the app runs as
